observations.name: Disable or Modify Tools
observations.justification: The API functions OpenProcess, TerminateProcess, WTSEnumerateProcessesW are all imported by the binary. This is a coherent enumerate-then-kill primitive: deliberately searching the process list (WTSEnumerateProcessesW) rather than acting on a handle already held, then opening and terminating a match. Consistent with Disable or Modify Tools (T1685) even without a decrypted target name to confirm which process is targeted -- medium rather than high confidence for that reason.
